description: Job Title: Business Analyst/QA Specialist Job Description The Business Analyst/QA Specialist plays a key role in translating business, user, and product needs into clear, actionable requirements that support software and platform development in a complex, compliance-driven environment. This position partners closely with product, engineering, and quality assurance teams to ensure requirements are technically sound, testable, and fully traceable across the system lifecycle. Responsibilities Elicit, analyze, and document business, user, and product requirements that capture functional, non-functional, and compliance-related needs. Partner with Product Owners, Engineering, and QA teams to ensure requirements are technically sound, testable, and interconnected across systems. Analyze how requirements impact one another and identify dependencies, constraints, and interactions within integrated system components. Ensure compliance-driven and policy-related requirements are accurately reflected and traceable throughout the system lifecycle. Support QA processes by linking requirements to test cases and validation criteria to achieve complete coverage and end-to-end traceability. Maintain organized, high-quality documentation across Jira, Confluence, and related collaboration and tracking tools. Facilitate requirement review sessions to confirm accuracy, resolve ambiguities, and promote shared understanding across delivery teams. Interpret data flows, system integrations, and functional dependencies to inform requirement design and impact analysis. Collaborate with stakeholders from both technical and business domains to align requirements with strategic objectives and user needs. Essential Skills Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Systems Analyst supporting software or platform development. Bachelors degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Proven experience in requirements gathering and documentation across business, user, and product domains. Strong understanding of how business, user, and product requirements interrelate within complex system environments. Technical fluency sufficient to interpret data flows, system integrations, and functional dependencies. Experience supporting QA workflows and maintaining requirements-to-test-case traceability. Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to break down complex problems and define clear, structured requirements. Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge technical and business audiences and facilitate collaborative discussions. Ability to ensure compliance and security-related requirements are incorporated into system design and documentation. Additional Skills & Qualifications Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for requirements management, documentation, and collaboration. Experience supporting government programs or compliance-driven software delivery initiatives. Knowledge of NIST standards, FedRAMP

Job Title: Industrial Engineering Analytics Engineer Job Description The Industrial Engineering Analytics Engineer leads the development and application of advanced analytical models to improve manufacturing efficiency, capacity planning, and cost optimization in large-scale production environments. Utilize and develop factory simulation models (such as FlexSim, AnyLogic, and similar tools) to analyze throughput, bottlenecks, and overall system performance. Support factory ramp-up, equipment installation, and operational readiness through model validation and performance tracking. Collaborate with manufacturing, operations, supply chain, finance, and engineering teams to align models with real-world constraints and business needs. Translate complex analytical outputs into clear, executive-level insights and recommendations for senior stakeholders. Work closely with MES and controls teams to integrate shop-floor data with industrial engineering models, ensuring accurate OEE measurement and enabling real-time, scalable dashboards for operational visibility and executive decision-making. Introduce and implement AI-driven tools and platforms to enhance industrial engineering analytics and decision-making. Job Title: Lab Analyst Job Description The Lab Analyst performs routine environmental sample testing using GC and GC-MS instrumentation in a dedicated analytical laboratory. This role focuses on applying EPA Method 8260 and established laboratory procedures to generate accurate, high-quality data while maintaining strong documentation and adherence to safety and quality standards. It is an excellent opportunity for an early-career laboratory professional to deepen hands-on experience with analytical instrumentation and environmental testing methods. Responsibilities Perform routine environmental sample testing using GC and GC-MS instrumentation. Conduct analyses in accordance with EPA Method 8260 and established laboratory procedures. Prepare and process environmental samples for instrumental analysis, ensuring proper handling and labeling. Operate and monitor GC and GC-MS instruments during analysis to ensure reliable performance. Perform routine instrument calibration and quality-control activities to maintain data integrity. Review analytical data for accuracy, precision, and compliance with laboratory procedures and quality requirements. Accurately document sample information, testing activities, and analytical results in laboratory records and systems. Assist with basic instrument troubleshooting and routine maintenance of GC and GC-MS equipment. Follow all laboratory standard operating procedures (SOPs), quality protocols, and safety procedures at all times. Maintain an organized, clean, and safe laboratory workspace to support efficient operations. Work a consistent first-shift schedule from Tuesday through Saturday to support laboratory testing needs. Essential Skills 612+ months of hands-on laboratory experience. Experience working with GC and/or GC-MS instrumentation. Environmental laboratory experience. Familiarity with EPA Method 8260 for environmental testing. Ability to follow established analytical methods, SOPs, and quality procedures. Strong attention to detail in both analytical work and documentation. Ability to accurately record sample information, testing steps, and results. Capability to work a consistent TuesdaySaturday schedule on first shift. Additional Skills & Qualifications EPA Method 8260 experience is highly preferred. Experience with VOC (volatile organic compound) analysis is a plus. Previous environmental laboratory experience is preferred. Interest in developing deeper technical experience with GC and GC-MS instrumentation. Motivation to build a career in environmental analytical testing within an established laboratory environment. Work Environment This role is based 100% onsite in an environmental analytical laboratory and follows a first-shift schedule, Tuesday through Saturday, from 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM. The position is fully hands-on, working directly with environmental samples and analytical instrumentation such as GC and GC-MS systems. The laboratory environment emphasizes adherence to SOPs, quality standard

Job Title: Nuclear Safety Analyst Job Description The Nuclear Safety Analyst role focuses on nuclear analysis and modeling rather than traditional plant mechanical design. You will work alongside experienced nuclear safety specialists to support advanced reactor and fuel development projects, performing a mix of research and customer-focused work. Assignments range from fundamental engineering calculations to detailed reactor analyses using specialized nuclear safety-analysis software. Model reactor and system thermal-hydraulic behavior under a variety of operating and safety conditions. Analyze heat transfer and fluid behavior in nuclear systems, including core and safety-system performance. Use specialized engineering and nuclear-analysis software such as RELAP5-3D and TRACE to simulate reactor response. Support analysis of reactor and core behavior under normal operation, transients, and postulated accident scenarios. Document methodologies, assumptions, input models, calculations, and conclusions in a clear and traceable manner. Job Title: Senior Structural Analyst (NASTRAN, PATRAN) Job Description The Senior Structural Analyst provides stress and structural analysis support for conceptual design activities on aerospace nacelle and thrust reverser systems. This role focuses on finite element model development using MSC Nastran/Patran, coordination across multidisciplinary engineering teams, and preparation of analysis documentation to support concept design reviews and new development projects. Responsibilities Provide structural and stress analysis support for project conceptual design activities on aerospace components, including nacelles and thrust reversers. Perform trade studies in coordination with engineering leadership to refine and optimize conceptual designs. Develop and maintain finite element models (FEM) using MSC Nastran and Patran to evaluate structural performance. Manage design iterations and associated data within the product lifecycle management (PLM) system to ensure configuration control and traceability. Coordinate with cross-functional teams to conduct feasibility studies and assess design options for structural integrity, manufacturability, and performance. Collaborate with mass properties specialists to develop estimates for weight, center of gravity, and moments for conceptual designs. Prepare clear and concise engineering presentations to communicate analysis results, design trade-offs, and recommendations. Create analysis reports and technical documentation in formats such as PowerPoint and Word to support program reviews and decision-making. Participate actively in Concept Design Reviews by presenting structural analysis findings and supporting design decisions. Support system integration activities as needed, including contributing to requirements development from a structural and stress analysis perspective. Provide periodic status updates on assigned tasks and coordinate effectively with project focal points to meet schedule and technical objectives.
